summary:
All tests pass. The needle was the classic DataLoader anti-pattern: `userResolver.ts` and `postResolver.ts` each created brand-new `DataLoader` instances inside individual resolver calls, so every loader only ever saw 1 key and batching never kicked in (query count would've been ~100+ instead of 15).

Fix: loaders are now created once per request in `context.ts` (via the already-correct `createLoaders` in `loaders.ts`) and shared through `ctx.loaders` across all resolvers. Query count dropped to 2 for fetching 100 users with their posts, well under the 15-query threshold.
